name: Planet Attack [ Alpha ]
desc:
💥 Planet Attack!! 💥
🚀 Experience the ultimate combination of pet collecting and base building madness!

Planet Attack is the game that merges the thrill of pet hatching simulations, setting up an impenetrable defense, and engaging in fierce PvP attacks, all in one place!

💰 Hatch, Empower, Get Rich!
Hatch & Stack Cash: Start by hatching rare and mighty pets! Each pet automatically generates income for you, making you rich non-stop, even while you sleep!

Collect Them All: Gather hundreds of unique creatures to supercharge your income stream!

🛡️ Build an Empire as Strong as a Mountain!
Upgrade to the Max: Use your earnings to upgrade your base like a boss! Increase your base's HP for unmatched durability, or upgrade your cannons to boost their destructive power and wipe out invaders!

Transform Your Crib: Turn your humble starting base into an impenetrable fortress that no one can breach!

😈 Invade, Plunder, and Conquer!
